question: Who has been awarded the Padma Shri in the year 2022 in the field of Science and Engineering?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subbanna Ayyappan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Subbanna Ayyappan** has been awarded the Padma Shri in the year 2022 in the field of Science and Engineering.
 
• The Padma Shri is the fourth highest civilian award in the Republic of India, awarded to citizens of India to recognize their distinguished contributions in various spheres of activity, including the Arts, Education, Industry, Literature, Science, Sports, Medicine, Social Service, and Public Affairs.
 
• Subbanna Ayyappan is renowned for his contributions to agricultural science and has been recognized for his significant work in this field.
 
• The award is announced annually on the occasion of Republic Day and is conferred by the President of India at ceremonial functions held at Rashtrapati Bhavan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Padma Awards** were instituted in the year 1954 and are announced every year on Republic Day, except for brief interruptions during the years 1978 and 1979 and 1993 to 1997.
 
• The awards are given in three categories: Padma Vibhushan (for exceptional and distinguished service), Padma Bhushan (for distinguished service of high order), and Padma Shri (for distinguished service in any field).
 
• The selection process for the Padma Awards is carried out by the Padma Awards Committee, constituted by the Prime Minister of India every year.
 
• Recommendations for Padma Awards can be made by the state governments, union territories, central ministries, institutions of excellence, and even individuals.
 
• Recipients of the Padma Awards are announced on the eve of Republic Day and are conferred the award by the President of India in a ceremonial function held at Rashtrapati Bhavan.
